scripts.server: cd src/backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080
scripts.matcher: docker compose stop matcher && cd src/matcher && uv run --system-certs --env-file ../backend/.env python -m matcher
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix src/frontend install && npm --prefix plugins/warehouse install && npm --prefix plugins/box-size install && npm --prefix plugins/ai-description install && npm --prefix plugins/events install
scripts.dev:all: docker compose stop backend matcher && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n web,server,matcher -c blue,green,magenta "npm run web" "npm run server" "npm run matcher"
